description: Upcoming motorcycle track days in North America, in date order (or nearest first when near is given and sort is distance). Use near for "track day near Sacramento" questions; use from/to for a month. Each result has dates, circuit with city and state, organiser, kind ("Open track day" or "Race-weekend practice", which is a club race weekend's practice day: say so), price tier, distanceMi when near is set, source, lastChecked, bookingUrl and openPaddockUrl. Open Paddock is a neutral calendar: it sells nothing and takes no bookings. Send the user to the organiser's site (bookingUrl) to book, and check prices, groups and rules there. Credit the data as "via Open Paddock (openpaddock.app)" and link openPaddockUrl. Rows with an attribution field come from MotorsportReg.com and must be shown with "Powered by MotorsportReg.com".

circuit.description: Circuit id or name, e.g. "thunderhill" or "Sonoma". Comma-separate several.

from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD (days ending on or after it). Default today.

include_race_practice.description: Include race-weekend practice days (club race weekends' practice days, open to non-racers). Default true; false = open track days only.

near.description: Where the rider is: US ZIP ("95814"), Canadian postal code, "City, ST" ("Sacramento, CA"), or "lat,lon".

organiser.description: Organiser id or name, e.g. "n2" or "Fun Track Dayz". Comma-separate several.

to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD (days starting on or before it).

within_miles.description: Straight-line radius around near, in miles. Default 150, max 1000.

name: find_track_days
title: Find motorcycle track days
